theme: Dark Theme Default with High-Contrast Precision Surfaces

layouts_and_grids.dialer_workspace: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 h-[calc(100vh-5rem)] p-4 md:p-6
layouts_and_grids.dialer_main_panel: lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col gap-6 h-full overflow-y-auto
layouts_and_grids.dialer_disposition_sidebar: lg:col-span-4 flex flex-col gap-6 h-full bg-slate-900/90 rounded-2xl p-6 border border-white/10
layouts_and_grids.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 p-6

key_components.name: Power Dialer Live Dock
key_components.description: Floating/Header-integrated control hub showing current contact name, number, call status (Idle/Ringing/In-Call/Ended), ticking call timer, Mute toggle button, Hang Up button, Keypad trigger, and Auto-Advance countdown banner with Pause/Skip controls.

key_components.name: Disposition Workflow Panel
key_components.description: Grid of quick outcome buttons (Interested, Not Interested, Voicemail, No Answer, Busy, Wrong Number, Callback Date Picker, Do Not Call), combined with rich notes textarea and Save & Auto-Advance trigger.

key_components.name: Contact Lists Manager
key_components.description: Drag & drop CSV uploader, list progress completion bars, agent assignment dropdowns, and interactive contact detail modal/drawer with real-time call status history.

key_components.name: Twilio Credentials & Status Card
key_components.description: Twilio Account SID, Auth Token mask inputs, active Caller ID dropdown selector, webhook health test button, and connection status indicator pill.

key_components.name: Call Logs Table
key_components.description: Dense filterable table displaying contact, agent name, call outcome badge, call duration timer, recording/notes preview, and CSV export option.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use plain Tailwind CSS v3/v4 classes with Lucide React icons. Do not rely on uninstalled external libraries.
Implement real-time call states in the Power Dialer (Idle, Ringing, In-Call, Call Ended) with simulated audio wave visualizers and countdown timers.
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, outcome tags, dropdown options) includes explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.
Provide CSV file drag-and-drop parsing logic for contact list uploads.
Support Clerk sign-in workflow layout with brand panel on the left/top and sign-in widgets.
Make sure tables are high-density, cleanly padded (py-3 px-4), and visually grouped with clear hover highlight rows.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow high-density dark mode styling with APCA-compliant text contrast. Expose clear state feedback with micro-animations. Ensure all forms and inputs have focus rings and distinct active states.
